autofilter_apply_1m: 1M rows: AutoFilter one category of 17 (941k rows hidden; no full recalc)
autofilter_clear_1m: 1M rows: turn the AutoFilter off (unhide 941k rows)
edit_chain_1m: 1M rows: type into A2, which feeds a 1M-long running total (~1M dependents)
edit_one_cell: Type one value into a 100k-row sheet (undo record + recalc). Target app: instant.
edit_one_cell_1m: 1M rows: type into a cell nothing depends on (undo record + recalc)
grid_layout_filtered_1m: 1M rows: lay out a screen at row 900k with 941k rows filtered out (frame budget)
grid_layout_screen: Lay out one 1600x1000 screen at row 50k (must fit in a frame)
grid_layout_screen_1m: 1M rows: lay out one 1600x1000 screen at row 900k (frame budget)
insert_row_1m: 1M rows: insert a row at the top (rewrite 4M formulas + recalc)
jump_end_1m: 1M rows: Ctrl+Down from A1 to the last row, plus laying out that screen
pdf_export: Export a 10k-row x 10-col report to PDF (paginate, lay out pages, write file)
peak_rss_1m_mb: 1M rows: peak resident memory of the whole 1M suite, in MB
recalc_full_cold: Full recalculation, cold AST cache (parse + evaluate 200k formulas)
recalc_full_cold_1m: 1M rows: full recalculation, cold AST cache (parse + evaluate 4M formulas)
recalc_full_warm_1m: 1M rows: full recalculation, warm AST cache
scroll_frame_1m: 1M rows: worst of 120 scroll frames (3 rows/frame) from row 900k (frame budget)
sort_rows: Sort 100k rows x 4 cols descending by column A
sort_rows_1m: 1M rows: sort 1M x 10 cols descending (shift 4M formulas + recalc)
